calibration_sources: NVIDIA NCCL 2.21–2.26 Documentation & Source Architecture (Ring, Tree, NVLS, PAT, LL/LL128/Simple, ncclCommRegister)
Megatron-Core & PyTorch FSDP2 Compute-Communication Overlap SM Contention Studies (132-SM H100 Wave Quantization)
NVIDIA Hopper/Blackwell NVLS (multimem.ld_reduce) & Hardware Copy Engine (CE) Collectives Benchmarks

workload.cluster_profile: 1,024-GPU H100/H200 Cluster (128 Nodes × 8 GPUs, 132 SMs/GPU, NVSwitch Intra-Node + 400G RoCEv2/IB Inter-Node)
workload.protocol_mechanics: LL = 8B atomic (4B data + 4B flag = 50% efficiency, ~1us latency); LL128 = 128B NVLink line (120B data + 8B flag = 93.75% efficiency); Simple = full MTU RDMA DMA with memory fence (100% payload efficiency, higher startup latency)
workload.sm_contention_problem: Each NCCL channel launches 1–2 CTAs occupying GPU SMs; over-allocating 32 channels steals SMs from overlapped Tensor Core GEMM

tiers.name: Tier 1: 盲目调大 32 通道 Ring + Simple (`NCCL_MAX_NCHANNELS=32`) (抢占 32 个 SM 拖慢矩阵乘 ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Naive 32-Channel Ring + Simple (`NCCL_MAX_NCHANNELS=32`) (Steals 32/132 SMs, Slows Overlapped GEMM)
tiers.recommended_for: Standalone nccl-tests synthetic bragging only; catastrophic in real overlapped training (1,024-rank linear ring latency + 25.5% GEMM slowdown).

tiers.name: Tier 2: 双叉树 Tree 算法 + 自动 LL/LL128/Simple 协议切换 (16 通道，消除千卡线性跳数)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Double Binary Tree + Auto LL/LL128/Simple Protocol Switching (16 Channels, O(log N) Hops)
tiers.recommended_for: Standard multi-node training on legacy PCIe or non-NVLS clusters where Tree + LL/LL128 cuts small-message latency by 7.0x.

tiers.name: Tier 3: NVLS (NVSwitch 硬件多播归约) + PAT 并行聚合树 (8 通道，高带宽低 SM 占用)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: NVLS (NVSwitch Hardware Multimem) + PAT Binomial Tree (8 Channels, High BW with Low SM Footprint)
tiers.recommended_for: H100/H200/B200 NVSwitch clusters running FSDP/Megatron where NVLS offloads intra-node reduction to NVSwitch silicon.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 零拷贝 User Buffer 注册 (`ncclCommRegister`) + NVLS + Copy Engine DMA (仅占 2~4 SM 🏆)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Zero-Copy User Buffer (`ncclCommRegister`) + NVLS + Copy Engine P2P DMA (Only 2-4 SMs, 97.8% GEMM Overlap)
tiers.recommended_for: Production 1,024+ GPU overlapped 3D/FSDP2 training & low-latency TP decode: frees 29 SMs back to Tensor Cores (+18.3 pts MFU vs Tier 1).
